name: Hana Bank
verdict: KEB Hana Bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of Korea Exchange-listed Hana Financial Group, whose largest shareholder is South Korea's National Pension Service (8.69%). Nothing found.
note: Main front (chest) sponsor of Daejeon Hana Citizen 2026 home kit, per the club's 2026-01-02 kit launch and the club store's '2026 필드 홈 유니폼' product render. Rating note: ownership chain documented (see claims); METHOD.md names South Korea's pension fund as an example of a public holder that is not a link to abuse. Quick company check (2026-09-30): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Hana Bank or Hana Financial Group found.
